supplemental_runtime_art_requirements.state: empty furnished room background; no baked actors/pets, UI or text
supplemental_runtime_art_requirements.required_pose: Room has a clear standing/follower floor, furniture/perch and wall display space; no public Hub NPCs/stations. Keep current approved architectural/material language.
supplemental_runtime_art_requirements.occupied_bounds: Full bleed background; protect UI zones y<240 and y>1900. Keep floor beneath actor baseline y1823 in this canvas.
supplemental_runtime_art_requirements.pivot: Background top-left; uniform cover scaling preserves aspect ratio
supplemental_runtime_art_requirements.layers: Empty furnished background; optional separate perch/shelf/shadow layers. Characters, pets, reward items, UI and transient lights remain separate.
supplemental_runtime_art_requirements.why_existing_source_cannot_close: Approved Home panel is landscape, low-resolution and baked with all six companion bodies. Cropping/erasing them cannot produce complete empty furniture/floor pixels; cannot show unequipped pets or call this a finished room.

authority: Existing locked identity; final production art cannot be inferred from rejected boards
count_unit: body/view bundles, each containing reusable pose states plus exact family/socket restrictions; not unique files per delivery cell

packages.layering_rules: Preserve body/weapon depth, existing target facing, paw contact, support/nock/paired sockets; no baked replacement identity

primary_socket.coordinate_space: existing rig local units; initial READY target, phase-specific source artist alignment required
primary_socket.source_pixels_status: OPEN until the actual requested state is authored; do not invent anatomy to meet a coordinate

requirements.why_existing_source_cannot_close: No accepted source frame has this exact state/facing and hand/weapon contract. Neutral exports cannot substitute for movement/strike/hurt/defeat; an asymmetric view cannot be mirrored; source palms and support layers cannot be invented.
requirements.weapon_contract: Exact family-specific export; a baked weapon must be declared and restricted. Otherwise deliver intact weaponless hands and separate equipment layers.
requirements.source_scale: Deliver at requested canvas dimensions with uniform scale and complete source silhouette; no stretch or invented covered pixels.
requirements.allowed_baked_vfx: Permanent canonical markings/glow only; any source-baked temporal effect requires explicit state restriction and provenance.
requirements.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. Register approved delivery in the existing per-state manifest; never route another state implicitly. Compatible identical bodies may share a single PNG only after family socket validation.

occupied_bounds.rule: Full silhouette inside these bounds; match per-ID proportions and existing ground target, not a stretched square.

requirements.visible_anatomy: Complete head/ears, torso/hips, source-authored limbs, feet/tail and relevant hands; palms/grips must not be obscured by charge, trails, sheet text or another pose. Do not reconstruct covered anatomy.
requirements.required_pose: Grounded neutral ready pose; complete canonical silhouette and actual equipment-contact palms.
separate_layers_required: foreground grip fingers when equipment passes behind the palm
family weapon module unless explicitly declared source-baked
second independent weapon and palm for paired families
bowstring/nocked arrow and drawing palm for Bow
temporal charge/trail/impact/status VFX separate from body

requirements.allowed_baked_vfx: Permanent canonical markings/glow only; any source-baked temporal effect requires explicit state restriction and provenance.
requirements.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. requirements.why_existing_source_cannot_close: No accepted source frame has this exact state/facing and hand/weapon contract. Neutral exports cannot substitute for movement/strike/hurt/defeat; an asymmetric view cannot be mirrored; source palms and support layers cannot be invented.
requirements.weapon_contract: Exact family-specific export; a baked weapon must be declared and restricted. Otherwise deliver intact weaponless hands and separate equipment layers.
requirements.source_scale: Deliver at requested canvas dimensions with uniform scale and complete source silhouette; no stretch or invented covered pixels.
requirements.allowed_baked_vfx: Permanent canonical markings/glow only; any source-baked temporal effect requires explicit state restriction and provenance.
requirements.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. Register approved delivery in the existing per-state manifest; never route another state implicitly. Compatible identical bodies may share a single PNG only after family socket validation.

occupied_bounds.rule: Full silhouette inside these bounds; match per-ID proportions and existing ground target, not a stretched square.

requirements.visible_anatomy: Complete head/ears, torso/hips, source-authored limbs, feet/tail and relevant hands; palms/grips must not be obscured by charge, trails, sheet text or another pose. Do not reconstruct covered anatomy.
requirements.required_pose: Authored target-directed strike or casting release; lead hand/weapon drives the action.
separate_layers_required: foreground grip fingers when equipment passes behind the palm
family weapon module unless explicitly declared source-baked
second independent weapon and palm for paired families
bowstring/nocked arrow and drawing palm for Bow
temporal charge/trail/impact/status VFX separate from body

requirements.source_scale: Deliver at requested canvas dimensions with uniform scale and complete source silhouette; no stretch or invented covered pixels.
requirements.allowed_baked_vfx: Permanent canonical markings/glow only; any source-baked temporal effect requires explicit state restriction and provenance.
requirements.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. Register approved delivery in the existing per-state manifest; never route another state implicitly. Compatible identical bodies may share a single PNG only after family socket validation.

occupied_bounds.rule: Full silhouette inside these bounds; match per-ID proportions and existing ground target, not a stretched square.

family weapon module unless explicitly declared source-baked

requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. requirements.allowed_baked_vfx: Permanent canonical markings/glow only; any source-baked temporal effect requires explicit state restriction and provenance.
requirements.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. requirements.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. requirements.source_scale: Deliver at requested canvas dimensions with uniform scale and complete source silhouette; no stretch or invented covered pixels.
requirements.allowed_baked_vfx: Permanent canonical markings/glow only; any source-baked temporal effect requires explicit state restriction and provenance.
requirements.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. requirements.why_existing_source_cannot_close: No accepted source frame has this exact state/facing and hand/weapon contract. Neutral exports cannot substitute for movement/strike/hurt/defeat; an asymmetric view cannot be mirrored; source palms and support layers cannot be invented.
requirements.weapon_contract: Exact family-specific export; a baked weapon must be declared and restricted. Otherwise deliver intact weaponless hands and separate equipment layers.
requirements.source_scale: Deliver at requested canvas dimensions with uniform scale and complete source silhouette; no stretch or invented covered pixels.
requirements.allowed_baked_vfx: Permanent canonical markings/glow only; any source-baked temporal effect requires explicit state restriction and provenance.
requirements.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. Register approved delivery in the existing per-state manifest; never route another state implicitly. Compatible identical bodies may share a single PNG only after family socket validation.

occupied_bounds.rule: Full silhouette inside these bounds; match per-ID proportions and existing ground target, not a stretched square.

family weapon module unless explicitly declared source-baked
second independent weapon and palm for paired families
bowstring/nocked arrow and drawing palm for Bow
temporal charge/trail/impact/status VFX separate from body

requirements.source_scale: Deliver at requested canvas dimensions with uniform scale and complete source silhouette; no stretch or invented covered pixels.
requirements.allowed_baked_vfx: Permanent canonical markings/glow only; any source-baked temporal effect requires explicit state restriction and provenance.
requirements.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. requirements.why_existing_source_cannot_close: No accepted source frame has this exact state/facing and hand/weapon contract. requirements.weapon_contract: Exact family-specific export; a baked weapon must be declared and restricted. Otherwise deliver intact weaponless hands and separate equipment layers.
requirements.source_scale: Deliver at requested canvas dimensions with uniform scale and complete source silhouette; no stretch or invented covered pixels.
requirements.allowed_baked_vfx: Permanent canonical markings/glow only; any source-baked temporal effect requires explicit state restriction and provenance.
requirements.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. Register approved delivery in the existing per-state manifest; never route another state implicitly. Compatible identical bodies may share a single PNG only after family socket validation.

separate_layers_required: foreground grip fingers when equipment passes behind the palm
family weapon module unless explicitly declared source-baked

bowstring/nocked arrow and drawing palm for Bow

requirements.why_existing_source_cannot_close: No accepted source frame has this exact state/facing and hand/weapon contract. Neutral exports cannot substitute for movement/strike/hurt/defeat; an asymmetric view cannot be mirrored; source palms and support layers cannot be invented. Existing original hooded rogue idle has baked daggers; removal would require missing covered paw/anatomy pixels.
requirements.weapon_contract: Exact family-specific export; a baked weapon must be declared and restricted. Otherwise deliver intact weaponless hands and separate equipment layers.
requirements.source_scale: Deliver at requested canvas dimensions with uniform scale and complete source silhouette; no stretch or invented covered pixels.
requirements.allowed_baked_vfx: Permanent canonical markings/glow only; any source-baked temporal effect requires explicit state restriction and provenance.
requirements.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. Register approved delivery in the existing per-state manifest; never route another state implicitly. Compatible identical bodies may share a single PNG only after family socket validation.

occupied_bounds.rule: Full silhouette inside these bounds; match per-ID proportions and existing ground target, not a stretched square.

requirements.visible_anatomy: Complete head/ears, torso/hips, source-authored limbs, feet/tail and relevant hands; palms/grips must not be obscured by charge, trails, sheet text or another pose. Do not reconstruct covered anatomy.
requirements.required_pose: Recognizable authored defeated pose; complete anatomy and equipment layers.
separate_layers_required: foreground grip fingers when equipment passes behind the palm
family weapon module unless explicitly declared source-baked
second independent weapon and palm for paired families
bowstring/nocked arrow and drawing palm for Bow
temporal charge/trail/impact/status VFX separate from body

requirements.allowed_baked_vfx: Permanent canonical markings/glow only; any source-baked temporal effect requires explicit state restriction and provenance.
requirements.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. requirements.why_existing_source_cannot_close: No accepted source frame has this exact state/facing and hand/weapon contract. Neutral exports cannot substitute for movement/strike/hurt/defeat; an asymmetric view cannot be mirrored; source palms and support layers cannot be invented. Existing original hooded rogue idle has baked daggers; removal would require missing covered paw/anatomy pixels.
requirements.weapon_contract: Exact family-specific export; a baked weapon must be declared and restricted. Otherwise deliver intact weaponless hands and separate equipment layers.
requirements.source_scale: Deliver at requested canvas dimensions with uniform scale and complete source silhouette; no stretch or invented covered pixels.
requirements.allowed_baked_vfx: Permanent canonical markings/glow only; any source-baked temporal effect requires explicit state restriction and provenance.
requirements.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. Register approved delivery in the existing per-state manifest; never route another state implicitly. Compatible identical bodies may share a single PNG only after family socket validation.

family weapon module unless explicitly declared source-baked

requirements.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. requirements.why_existing_source_cannot_close: No accepted source frame has this exact state/facing and hand/weapon contract. Neutral exports cannot substitute for movement/strike/hurt/defeat; an asymmetric view cannot be mirrored; source palms and support layers cannot be invented.
requirements.weapon_contract: Exact family-specific export; a baked weapon must be declared and restricted. Otherwise deliver intact weaponless hands and separate equipment layers.
requirements.source_scale: Deliver at requested canvas dimensions with uniform scale and complete source silhouette; no stretch or invented covered pixels.
requirements.allowed_baked_vfx: Permanent canonical markings/glow only; any source-baked temporal effect requires explicit state restriction and provenance.
requirements.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. Register approved delivery in the existing per-state manifest; never route another state implicitly. Compatible identical bodies may share a single PNG only after family socket validation.

family weapon module unless explicitly declared source-baked
second independent weapon and palm for paired families
bowstring/nocked arrow and drawing palm for Bow

requirements.source_scale: Deliver at requested canvas dimensions with uniform scale and complete source silhouette; no stretch or invented covered pixels.
requirements.allowed_baked_vfx: Permanent canonical markings/glow only; any source-baked temporal effect requires explicit state restriction and provenance.
requirements.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. Register approved delivery in the existing per-state manifest; never route another state implicitly. Compatible identical bodies may share a single PNG only after family socket validation.

requirements.source_scale: Deliver at requested canvas dimensions with uniform scale and complete source silhouette; no stretch or invented covered pixels.
requirements.allowed_baked_vfx: Permanent canonical markings/glow only; any source-baked temporal effect requires explicit state restriction and provenance.
requirements.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. Register approved delivery in the existing per-state manifest; never route another state implicitly. Compatible identical bodies may share a single PNG only after family socket validation.

requirements.source_scale: Deliver at requested canvas dimensions with uniform scale and complete source silhouette; no stretch or invented covered pixels.
requirements.allowed_baked_vfx: Permanent canonical markings/glow only; any source-baked temporal effect requires explicit state restriction and provenance.
requirements.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. requirements.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment.
